article_content: Recent government data reveals that roughly a third of six-year-olds in England haven't yet met the expected reading level after a year in school.  While 69% of Year 1 students in state schools achieved the benchmark score of 32 out of 40 on the phonics screening check, this still leaves a significant number of youngsters needing additional support. This represents an 11% improvement from the prior year. The statistics, published by the Department for Education, showed a notable difference in performance between genders, with 73% of girls reaching the target compared to 65% of boys.  By the close of Year 2, that number increased to 85%. These findings stem from the 'synthetic phonics' tests implemented last year, a method which has drawn criticism from educators.  Teachers argue that asking pupils to read 40 words, half of which are made-up, doesn't accurately reflect their reading ability and may negatively label them.  Adding to the concern, a National Literacy Trust survey found that over 20% of children feel embarrassed reading books in public, a five percent jump from two years prior.  The Trust's research also highlighted a link between children's enjoyment of reading and their test performance. A concerning trend also shows a drop in children reading independently, down from 38% in 2005 to 24% today, and over a quarter of surveyed children aged 8-16 stated their parents weren't interested in their reading habits. The National Literacy Trust is countering these trends with their 'Literacy Heroes' campaign, endorsed by figures like Duchess of Cornwall, who champions inspiring a love for reading in the next generation. Separately, teacher assessments for seven-year-olds showed small increases in reading, writing, and speaking/listening, with maths results remaining static.  The debate around the phonics tests continues, with union leaders like Christine Blower of the NUT calling them 'pernicious' and highlighting the varied pace of child development.  Conversely, Education Minister Elizabeth Truss emphasized the tests' role in identifying pupils needing extra reading support, leading to improved reading skills and a love of reading.

Bis zum Ende des zweiten Schuljahres stieg diese Zahl auf 85%. Umgekehrt betonte Bildungsministerin Elizabeth Truss die Rolle der Tests bei der Identifizierung von Schüler*innen, die zusätzliche Lesehilfe benötigen, was zu verbesserten Lesefähigkeiten und Leselust führt.

article_content: Google's newly launched Chrome Web Store aims to revolutionize web applications, similar to how Apple's App Store transformed mobile apps.  This store is integrated with Google's Chrome OS, a browser-focused operating system.  Essentially, Google predicts a future where your web browser becomes your primary computing platform.  They argue that in today's online-centric world, operating systems like Windows or Mac OS are no longer essential.  Google's vision involves computers that boot directly into a web browser powered by the streamlined Chrome OS.  In this scenario, web applications replace desktop software, storing your data and programs online.  However, understanding Google's ambition is challenging because the necessary components aren't fully in place.  Despite the Chrome browser's increasing popularity (around 10% market share), Chrome OS devices are still rare.  This means Google has launched an app store before the widespread availability of compatible devices.  While early adopters might embrace this change, it's a significant leap for most users accustomed to traditional desktops and applications.  The success of the Chrome Web Store is likely tied to the release of Chrome OS devices, expected next year.  This will allow consumers to experience the simplicity of this browser-centric computing model firsthand.

Im Wesentlichen prognostiziert Google eine Zukunft, in der Ihr Webbrowser zu Ihrer primären Computing-Plattform wird.  Sie argumentieren, dass in der heutigen online-zentrierten Welt Betriebssysteme wie Windows oder Mac OS nicht mehr unbedingt erforderlich sind. Googles Vision umfasst Computer, die direkt in einem Webbrowser starten, der vom optimierten Chrome OS unterstützt wird. In diesem Szenario ersetzen Webanwendungen Desktop-Software und speichern Ihre Daten und Programme online. Es ist jedoch schwierig, Googles Ambitionen zu verstehen, da die notwendigen Komponenten noch nicht vollständig vorhanden sind. Trotz der zunehmenden Beliebtheit des Chrome-Browsers (rund 10 % Marktanteil) sind Chrome OS-Geräte noch selten. Das bedeutet, dass Google einen App Store eröffnet hat, bevor kompatible Geräte flächendeckend verfügbar sind. Während Early Adopter diese Veränderung möglicherweise begrüßen, ist sie für die meisten Benutzer, die an traditionelle Desktops und Anwendungen gewöhnt sind, ein erheblicher Schritt. Der Erfolg des Chrome Web Stores hängt wahrscheinlich mit der Veröffentlichung von Chrome OS-Geräten zusammen, die nächstes Jahr erwartet wird. Dadurch können Verbraucher die Einfachheit dieses browserzentrierten Computing-Modells aus erster Hand erleben.

article_content: 'A Dutch entertainer, Gerard Dogge (stage name Gerard Bakardy), is being sued by Raymond Teller for threatening to reveal the secret behind the \'Shadows\' illusion, a signature Penn & Teller magic trick. Dogge posted a YouTube video offering to expose the method for $3,050. Teller, claiming copyright to the trick, contacted Dogge and YouTube demanding removal of the video.  He initially offered to pay the requested sum, but Dogge allegedly countered with a much higher amount, then threatened to sell the secret if Teller didn't agree to his terms.  The lawsuit, filed in Las Vegas federal court, seeks to stop the infringement and recover damages. The \'Shadows\' illusion involves a rose in a vase, a spotlight, and a projected shadow on a screen. Teller manipulates the shadow, causing corresponding changes to the real rose.  The trick, copyrighted in 1983, is described as a cornerstone of Penn & Teller's act, performed thousands of times since 1976.  Teller claims he invented the trick as a teenager.  Celebrities like Jason Alexander have praised the illusion's poetic nature.  The lawsuit has implications for the magic community, which emphasizes secrecy among its members. Dogge has not publicly commented.'

Dogge veröffentlichte ein YouTube-Video, in dem er anbot, die Methode für 3.050 Dollar zu enthüllen. Teller, der das Urheberrecht an dem Trick beansprucht, kontaktierte Dogge und YouTube und verlangte die Entfernung des Videos. Er bot zunächst an, die geforderte Summe zu zahlen, aber Dogge forderte angeblich einen viel höheren Betrag und drohte dann, das Geheimnis zu verkaufen, falls Teller seinen Bedingungen nicht zustimmen würde. Die in Las Vegas eingereichte Klage zielt darauf ab, die Urheberrechtsverletzung zu unterbinden und Schadenersatz zu erhalten. Die \'Shadows\'-Illusion zeigt eine Rose in einer Vase, einen Scheinwerfer und einen projizierten Schatten auf einem Bildschirm. Teller manipuliert den Schatten, wodurch entsprechende Veränderungen an der echten Rose hervorgerufen werden. Der 1983 urheberrechtlich geschützte Trick gilt als ein Eckpfeiler von Penn & Tellers Show und wurde seit 1976 tausendfach aufgeführt. Teller behauptet, den Trick als Teenager erfunden zu haben. article_content: 'New Zealand is well-prepared for their Cricket World Cup match against Bangladesh in Chennai, having recently played a series against them, opener Devon Conway said. 'We're pleased with our two wins,' Conway said. 'Bangladesh are a strong team with skilled spinners and seamers, but we have a good understanding of their strategies.' Conway also praised teammate Rachin Ravindra's recent performances, including a significant partnership with him in the win over England. 'Rachin is a talented young player with a mature mindset,' Conway said. 'He deserves the recognition he's receiving.'

article_content: 'A multi-millionaire businessman, Khoo Kay Peng, and his estranged wife, Pauline Chai, are embroiled in a costly High Court divorce battle. The couple, married for over 40 years and with five adult children, are disputing the jurisdiction of the proceedings, with Mr. Khoo, 75, preferring Malaysia and Mrs. Chai, a former beauty queen in her 60s, favoring England.  The core issue revolves around the financial settlement, with Mrs. Chai seeking a significant portion of Mr. Khoo's substantial fortune, estimated to exceed £400 million.  In July, Mr. Justice Bodey urged the pair to reach a resolution, noting the already exorbitant legal fees exceeding £2 million.  Mr. Khoo, who owns part of Laura Ashley and has properties in both England and Malaysia worth over £50 million, is based in Malaysia. Mrs. Chai now resides in England.'

article_content: 'On Sunday, India experienced a heartbreaking defeat against Australia in the ODI World Cup final at Ahmedabad's Narendra Modi Stadium. The Indian players were visibly emotional after the six-wicket loss, which prevented them from securing their third World Cup title.  Australia, on the other hand, celebrated their sixth championship. Virat Kohli, despite winning the 'Player of the Series' award for his impressive 765 runs across 11 matches, couldn't secure the ultimate prize. While Kohli (54) and KL Rahul (66) contributed half-centuries, India only managed to post 240 runs after being put in to bat by Australian captain Pat Cummins.  Australian opener Travis Head's stellar 137-run knock proved decisive, guiding his team to victory with seven overs remaining.  Head and Marnus Labuschagne (58) forged a crucial 192-run partnership, rescuing Australia from a precarious 47/3.'

Die indischen Spieler waren nach der Niederlage mit sechs Wickets sichtlich emotional, die sie daran hinderte, ihren dritten Weltcup-Titel zu erringen. Australien hingegen feierte die sechste Meisterschaft. Virat Kohli konnte trotz des Gewinns der Auszeichnung 'Spieler der Serie' für seine beeindruckenden 765 Runs in 11 Spielen nicht den ultimativen Preis gewinnen.  Obwohl Kohli (54) und KL Rahul (66)  Half-Centuries erzielten, schaffte es Indien nur, 240 Runs zu erzielen, nachdem sie von dem australischen Kapitän Pat Cummins zum Schlagen aufgefordert worden waren. Der herausragende 137-Run-Knock des australischen Openers Travis Head erwies sich als entscheidend und führte sein Team sieben Overs vor dem Ende zum Sieg. Head und Marnus Labuschagne (58) schmiedeten eine entscheidende 192-Run Partnerschaft und retteten Australien aus einer prekären 47/3.'

article_content: In a bizarre incident in Hemel Hempstead, a man found himself in a predicament after placing a traffic bollard over his head while joking around with friends.  The plastic cone became firmly lodged, trapping him for over two hours on a Sunday afternoon.  Bemused shoppers observed the man's struggle, initially assuming it was a prank. Eventually, a police officer arrived at the scene outside Burger King to assist. With the help of the man's friend, the officer managed to pull him free from the cone.  The man, red-faced and relieved, expressed his gratitude to the officer. Roofer John Waterman, 28, who witnessed and filmed the event, commented on the unusual nature of the situation.  'It’s not every day you see something like that in Hemel Hempstead,' Waterman remarked, adding that the man appeared distressed by the end of his ordeal. His back was scratched from the bollard’s removal.

Verwirrte Passanten beobachteten die missliche Lage des Mannes und nahmen zunächst an, es handle sich um einen Streich. Schließlich traf ein Polizist vor einem Burger King ein, um zu helfen. Der Dachdecker John Waterman, 28, der den Vorfall miterlebte und filmte, kommentierte die ungewöhnliche Situation. article_content: The scene in Miranshah, North Waziristan, is one of unsettling quiet. A tea shop stands still, an empty kettle a stark reminder of the life that once filled this town.  Now, only flies disturb the sweetmeats drying in the July sun. The Pakistani army's operation, Zarb-e-Azb, named after a famous sword of the prophet Muhammad, has left the streets eerily deserted.  Following weeks of airstrikes, ground troops moved into North Waziristan in mid-June. I was among a small group of journalists granted rare access to the region.  Accompanied by Maj. General Asim Bajwa, we toured the damaged town, now under military control. We passed abandoned villages like Machis, scarred by drone strikes and now guarded by soldiers. Nearby, a suspected al Qaeda compound, complete with a 'two-kilometer' network of tunnels, showcased the militants' sophisticated operations.  In Miranshah's ruined bazaar, a display of captured weapons served as a stark reminder of the conflict. Maj. General Zafar Khan, leading the operation, stated that 80% of the area has been cleared of militants, but much of the civilian population is gone too. The FATA Disaster Management Authority reports over 876,000 internally displaced persons.  The drive into Miranshah was surreal.  As soldiers discussed the previous night's World Cup match, we passed hollowed-out buildings. The threat of IEDs, 23 tons of which were recovered from the area, was ever-present.  In the bazaar's ruins, we saw evidence of the East Turkestan Islamic Movement's presence, including an in-house dental clinic.  A nearby mosque concealed an escape route, a testament to the militants' ingenuity. No one, it seems, was captured. Even as the military asserts its gains, a new group, Lashkar-e-Saif, claims control over other parts of Waziristan. This claim is refuted by the military, who maintain that militants will not return.  The future of North Waziristan remains precarious.

In Begleitung von Generalmajor Asim Bajwa besichtigten wir die beschädigte Stadt, die jetzt unter militärischer Kontrolle steht. article_content: According to TripAdvisor's latest Traveler's Choice awards, marine life is making a splash in the amusement park world.  Based on user reviews, Discovery Cove in Orlando, Florida, with its unique dolphin and tropical fish encounters, has earned the title of world's best amusement park.  Not to be outdone, Siam Park, a Thai-inspired water park in Tenerife, Spain, home to a playful sea lion colony, claimed the top spot for water parks. Orlando dominated the rankings, boasting five of the top 10 amusement parks, including three Disney properties.  Germany's Europa Park, known for its enchanting European theming, secured the second position, followed by Universal's Islands of Adventure, also in Orlando.  The water park list saw similar Orlando dominance, with Disney's Blizzard Beach and Typhoon Lagoon making the top 10.  Other notable contenders included Beach Park in Brazil and two Dubai water parks.

Siam Park, ein thailändisch inspirierter Wasserpark auf Teneriffa, der eine verspielte Seelöwenkolonie beherbergt, sicherte sich den Spitzenplatz bei den Wasserparks. Orlando dominierte die Ranglisten mit fünf der Top 10 Freizeitparks, darunter drei Disney-Parks.
